summary_en: The caller initiated the call to inquire about the cost of split AC servicing. The agent provided the price of 599 rupees. The caller identified himself as Kiran and requested that his enquiry be noted, stating that he was interested. The agent acknowledged the details but explained that additional information regarding the specific appliance and the issue faced was required to save the enquiry. The caller declined to provide further details, saying that was all for now, and thanked the agent. The agent then concluded the call.
